messages:
maria: heads up — we got a customer report: sample-app replayed requests after a 429 and caused duplicate invoices. suspect SDKs differ on 429 handling and idempotency defaults. @jonathan @kevin any quick thoughts?

jonathan: ugh. thanks for flagging. do we know which SDK and which code path? node or python?

maria: node sample-app (latest master). repro: send burst of requests, some get 429, sdk retries immediately w/o idempotency key. no Retry-After honor.

kevin: that matches an open issue — node SDK used a simple fixed backoff for 429s, and we missed adding Idempotency-Key on the sample app POST. also token refresh flow will re-run original request in some cases which is unsafe.

samir: i pushed a tiny patch locally adding `Idempotency-Key: uuid()` for create endpoints and honoring `Retry-After`. quick test reduced duplicates to 0 in my run. snippet: ```js fetch('/charge', { method:'POST', headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': id }}) ```

jonathan: we need an org-level guidance: default retries should be conservative for 429. prefer exponential backoff + full jitter and ALWAYS honor Retry-After header when present. safeReplay flag exposed by SDKs would be good so apps can opt into automatic replay when operation is idempotent.

kevin: agreed. and SDKs must expose error classification: transient (safe to retry), throttling (Respect Retry-After), and unrecoverable (no retry). current parity gap: python classifies 429 as throttling and reads Retry-After; node classifies as transient and ignores header.

maria: action items? i propose: (1) update node SDK to honor Retry-After and implement exponential+full-jitter default; (2) update sample-apps to add idempotency headers on mutating endpoints; (3) add `safeReplay` boolean on request options and document semantics.

jonathan: +1. also, add metrics for retry count per-request and duplicate-detection signals in console (cost/safety).

samir: one implementation detail — how long should idempotency keys live server-side? customers worried about storage. we currently keep keys 24h for charges. is that the recommendation?

kevin: 24h reasonable for billing. for other ops maybe shorter. we should document per-endpoint suggested TTLs.

maria: i'll open a ticket with checklist and assign initial work. minimal patch for node SDK: read `Retry-After`, parse seconds or HTTP-date, sleep until allowed, otherwise backoff base=300ms, max=10s, attempts=5 with full jitter.

jonathan: sample pseudo: ```
function backoff(attempt){
  const base = 300; const cap = 10000;
  const exp = Math.min(cap, base * Math.pow(2, attempt));
  return Math.random() * exp; // full jitter
}
```

maria: thanks. i'll also add a small note in onboarding docs warning about naive retries in sample apps.

devex-bot: created ticket DEVEX-1029 - "Retry handling parity & safe replay defaults" assigned to @maria, kevin, jonathan. :eyes:

kevin: i'll take the node SDK change and a small test harness. samir want to own sample-app fixes?

samir: happy to. will PR sample-app + tests for duplicate-detection.

maria: great. wrap up: we prefer Retry-After > honor, full jitter + exp backoff defaults, idempotency headers in sample apps, and expose safeReplay flag. i'll post follow-up with timeline. :thumbsup:
